entries.entry_name: Steam Breath — Saint Olms the Just
entries.mitigation: Main tank sidesteps the steam cone instead of eating it, then immediately restores Olms' facing away from the raid.

entries.entry_name: Lightning Circle — Saint Olms the Just
entries.mitigation: Keep designated front/back kiters as the farthest targets; move promptly out of each circle and preserve space for the next one.
Protectors are first priority. Kill them immediately before they stack immunity onto Olms or the active side Saints.

entries.entry_name: Side Saint Enrage — Saint Olms the Just
entries.mitigation: Burn active side Saints before their 3-minute enrage. When defeated they stay dormant for about 45 seconds, so coordinate kills to create a shared breathing window.

entries.entry_name: Llothis Interrupt — Saint Olms the Just
entries.mitigation: Interrupt Llothis' dangerous channels immediately and keep his poison cone isolated from the group.
